title: MediaTemplate
description: MEDIA-01. A reusable picture or video prompt skeleton. Blanks are filled when a creation is made; references are Library file ids. CREATOR-01: kind "fragment" is a short English prompt fragment (a camera, lens, light, grade and so on, in `prompt`, with its `group`) that the shot-card chips and the prompt builder read; it is not a template a person starts from. Reader rule: every template reader (the template list, the Create and Studio template pickers, the check.sh template validation) MUST skip fragment records, and only the fragment readers read them.

group.description: CREATOR-01. Which vocabulary a fragment belongs to: the shot-card groups, or the picture presets picture_look, relight, angle and format (CREATOR-13). Required when kind is fragment; absent otherwise.

prompt.description: Prompt skeleton with named blanks in braces.
